events.event_name: Cult Gaia Eau de Parfum Launch at Sephora SoHo
events.brand: Cult Gaia × Sephora × Go Greek Yogurt
events.address: Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway, New York, NY 10012
events.what_it_is: An open-house Sephora SoHo launch event for Cult Gaia Eau de Parfum, paired with complimentary Go Greek frozen yogurt inspired by the MAST, ZAN and NOOR fragrances.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary Go Greek frozen yogurt is advertised as part of the fragrance launch experience.
events.caveats: Sephora's current SoHo store-events page lists the Cult Gaia Soho Pop-up Launch Event as an exclusive open-house event beginning at 11 AM on September 15. NYC for FREE independently lists the activation from 11 AM–5 PM and the complimentary frozen-yogurt offer. No ticket, RSVP or purchase requirement is published for the open-house event.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 11 AM–5 PM at Sephora SoHo, 557 Broadway. Walk-in/open-house access; complimentary food is promotional inventory and may run out before closing.

occurrences.details: Walk-in Sephora open-house launch; complimentary Go Greek frozen yogurt is advertised.
